events.description:
Tries again. Given, a retry button is drawn first among the actions; while the returned promise is pending the
button shows a spinner and refuses presses, so a slow reload is not sent twice.
events.name: onRetry

props.description: The heading, in place of the preset's own.
props.name: title

props.description: The thrown value; its message shows as details outside production, as `ErrorState` decides.
props.name: error

props.description: Whether the error's message is shown; see `ErrorStateContractProps.isMessageShown`.
props.name: isMessageShown

props.description: The retry button's label; defaults to the catalogue's "Try again".
props.name: retryLabel

props.description: One or two sentences: why it is so, and what to do next.
props.name: description

props.description: An icon in place of the reason's or kind's own, or `false` for none.
props.name: icon

props.description: Buttons or links for the reader's next step, drawn under the description in a wrapping row.
props.name: actions

props.description: The title's place in the document outline, 1 to 6, so the page keeps one outline wherever this sits.
props.name: headingLevel

props.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).
props.name: ref
